caption: The drawing features a young girl wearing a long, light peach-pink dress with horizontal blue stripes along the lower skirt. Over the dress, she wears a textured, knee-length grey coat adorned with wide blue bands at the edges, cuffs, and collar. She has a blue sash tied at her waist in a bow and wears blue heeled boots with a row of yellow buttons on the sides. On her head, she dons a blue bonnet with lace trimming and blue ribbon details. The girl’s hands are visible, not covered by gloves. In the upper left corner of the image is a smaller rear-view depiction of the same figure and outfit, showing the blue sash tied at the back and the hairstyle, which is brown and styled close to the head. The background of the image is plain and unadorned, and the drawing is rendered in watercolor or ink with clear outlines.
title: Doll: "Rose Bates"
